questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most 100+ Scores' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Faye Tunnicliffe holds it, with a total of 2, a joint record shared with Tazmin Brits.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Best Batting Average' in the 14/15 season (T20)?
At which ground did Boland record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Boland Park, Paarl — highest total of 558, against Kei on 2011/01/29.

questions.question: At which ground did Tamzyn Hartman record their career-best innings (45, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Tuskers on 2023/11/19.

questions.question: At Centurion Park, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
Which South African bowler took the first-ever hat-trick in the history of the ICC Under-19 Women's T20 World Cup, in 2023?
questions.explanation: Landsman, then 18, took the first hat-trick in U19 Women's T20 World Cup history against Scotland in 2023.
